independenceStatement: This reviewer did not author or modify the reviewed production UI, validation harness, or immutable browser collection. The reviewer wrote only the assigned reviewer-report.json and reviewer-report.md and did not touch production UI, collection inputs, frozen design artifacts, specifications, task checkboxes, owner artifacts, Git staging, or commits.

buildIdentity.displayScaleBasis: The 1280x760 PNG equals the recorded 1280x760 CSS viewport; this is the browser capture scale and is not a claim about a physical macOS display.

reviewedCollections.role: semantic browser authority and fixed browser screenshot

visualChecks.expected: The 360px Overlay Sidebar covers the left editor area while its header, tree, divider, shadow, and full perimeter remain visible and reviewable.
visualChecks.actual: The Overlay Sidebar is visibly layered above the SDK editor and its shell-owned perimeter is not concealed by the SDK exclusion.

visualChecks.check: Canvas box remains unchanged when Overlay opens and closes
visualChecks.expected: Canvas x, y, width, and height remain exactly unchanged before and after the Overlay transition.
visualChecks.actual: The bound collector reports exact before/after equality at x=0, y=44, width=1280, and height=716. This geometry was accepted from the structured assertions and not re-proved from pixels.

visualChecks.expected: Back is a compact enabled 32x32 icon control beside Sidebar for the valid-history fixture.
visualChecks.actual: Back is visibly compact and the collector reports enabled semantics plus exact 32x32 geometry.

visualChecks.expected: The first Tab begins immediately after the compact Sidebar/Back group, as in the frozen HF2-04 baseline, within the declared ±2 CSS px shell-geometry tolerance.
visualChecks.actual: The baseline active underline begins at x=89, while the actual active underline begins at x=141, producing a 52px additional gap in the unmasked top shell.

visualChecks.expected: The dirty second Tab has a visible circular unsaved marker, matching the frozen screen and the Tab component contract.
visualChecks.actual: The actual Flow.excalidraw Tab has no visible unsaved marker even though the deterministic fixture declares it dirty.

visualChecks.expected: The Overlay key screen captures the compact Sidebar toggle at rest with transparent/default background, as shown in the frozen baseline.
visualChecks.actual: The actual capture shows the Sidebar toggle with the Light hover surface while Back remains at rest, so the key-screen state is inconsistent with the baseline default control state.

compositionChecks.check: Overlay Sidebar header, tree rows, divider, shadow, and perimeter remain visible and unmasked
Overlay canvas box before/after is exactly equal in all four dimensions
Back is enabled and preserves its compact 32x32 geometry
The first Tab preserves the frozen top-shell placement
The fixture-declared dirty second Tab preserves a visible unsaved marker
The Sidebar toggle is captured in the baseline default state rather than hover
No prohibited legacy shell chrome is visible

maskRationale: The declared selector is accepted only for the visible SDK editor interior. The reviewer did not exclude the Overlay Sidebar, its shadow/perimeter, the top Tabs, Sidebar/Back controls, Workspace header, or tree rows, even where the Overlay is visually stacked above the underlying editor.

tolerances.browserGeometryTolerance: ±2 CSS px; the bound collector owns the canvas-box and Back measurements, while the visible 52px Tab-placement deviation exceeds this tolerance

rasterOnlyTolerance.scope: collector-owned auxiliary workspace-sidebar repeated component crop only

findings.screenState: 04 · Workspace · Overlay · Light / top Tab strip placement
findings.expected: The first Tab begins immediately after the compact Sidebar/Back control group. In the manifest-verified baseline its active underline begins at x=89, subject to the declared ±2 CSS px shell-geometry tolerance.
findings.actual: In actual.png the first active underline begins at x=141. The resulting 52px extra gap is visible, unmasked, and changes the approved top-shell composition.
findings.reproduction: Open workspace-overlay-light.png and actual.png separately at their native 1280x760 size. Inspect scanline y=38 in the baseline and y=39 in the browser capture, accounting for their one-pixel rasterization offset: the first active underline begins at x=89 versus x=141. The difference is outside the SDK editor exclusion.

findings.screenState: 04 · Workspace · Overlay · Light / dirty second Tab
findings.expected: The dirty second Tab exposes a visible circular unsaved marker in addition to accessible text. The frozen HF2-04 baseline visibly includes this non-colour cue, and the deterministic overlay fixture declares its second Tab dirty.
findings.actual: Flow.excalidraw has no visible unsaved marker in actual.png. No warning-colour marker pixels are present in the captured top strip, leaving the fixture-declared dirty state without its required visible cue.
findings.reproduction: Open the manifest-verified baseline and actual.png separately at 100%. Compare the second Tab: the baseline includes a circular marker between title and close slot, while actual Flow.excalidraw does not. The Tab strip is app-owned and unmasked.

findings.screenState: 04 · Workspace · Overlay · Light / Sidebar toggle state
findings.expected: The fixed key screen shows the compact Sidebar toggle at rest with its approved transparent/default surface; hover is a separate component state.
findings.actual: The actual capture retains the Light hover surface behind the Sidebar toggle while Back is at rest. This makes the fixed Overlay composition state-dependent and differs visibly from the baseline.
findings.reproduction: Inspect the compact controls at the top-left of the two 1280x760 images. Baseline pixels around the Sidebar button background are white, while actual pixels around the same button use the lavender hover surface; the pointer is not part of the capture.

residualLowMediumFindings.description: The captured Sidebar toggle remains in hover styling rather than the baseline default state.

unverified: A native macOS package, bundle identifier, native window, physical display scale, native menus, and system dialogs were not reviewed; they are intentionally outside this intermediate browser-only checkpoint.
The browser engine name and version are not present in environment.json.
The recorded capture scale is derived from matching PNG and CSS viewport dimensions and does not establish the physical macOS display scale.

Back-history behavior, Overlay hold/Escape behavior, persistence, accessibility, font fallback, token values, mask semantics, and legacy counts were not re-proved from pixels; the immutable collector and focused regressions own those facts.
HF2-01, HF2-02, VSL-001/HF2-03, HF2-05, and HF2-06 were not reviewed by this single-screen checkpoint.
No product-owner decision was created or inferred because ownerRequirement is NOT_REQUIRED for HF2-04.
nextGate: Remediate the unmasked top-Tab placement, restore the fixture-declared dirty Tab marker, and capture the Sidebar toggle in the baseline default state.
